intro: This quest sends an adventurer carrying Furen Longbeard's crafting notes across the seas to Darnassus. The recipient is Mathiel, an artisan smith residing on the Warrior's Terrace eager to study dwarven innovations in mail forging. It represents a vital exchange of martial metallurgy between Ironforge and the kaldorei.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need them sent to the blacksmith Mathiel. He lives in Darnassus which is quite a long way off, but I'm sure he'll be very grateful to learn what I've learned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are interesting, very interesting indeed. My dwarven colleague Furen has made quite a grand discovery!
Thank you, friend. It will be an honor to apply his new techniques to my own craftings.
